notes.title: Updated Lighting System, Audio and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A random update for Consequence. I have been working on the sequel and other games, along with updating this one. After testing, this update is stable for release, so enjoy! The update aims to improve the lighting so the game looks less [i]paper[/i] like, along with adding bloom to the lights, fixing one of the achievements that doesn't work for some players, along with changing some of the music to correctly fit with the theme of the scene. Patch notes below, thank you as always!

Noodle :)

Patch Notes v1.2.1.2:

- Added post-processing effects (including bloom, vignette and more)
- Changed the first storm scene and the cave scene to have more [i]ambient[/i] music
- Killing all the sad men in the game is no longer impossible for some players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797409/47df57e4f70eaa115086747de528eaaf9e5cff23.png[/img]

notes.title: Consequence v1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am pleased to announce that Consequence v1.2 is finally out, improving lighting and graphics, and adding two new bosses, along with achievements and a boss rebalance, check patch notes below 

Noodle :)

Patch Notes v1.2
- Lowered the overall volume of the game by half
- Increased the damage of the melee attack from 40 to 100
- Updated the dialogue box texture
- Updated lighting
- Improved dialogue
- Added more depth and background
- Added platforming to the level when you first wake up
- Adjust camera FOV
- Fixed camera and scaling issues
- Added achievements
- Added arrows
- Drey the Bridgeman's health has been reduced to 3000 from 5000
- Completely revamped post-drey content
- Added the Maddie's shield mechanic
- Added a lot more sad men to kill, kill all of them for an achievment

Added 2 more bosses:
- Christopher the Manipulator
- Lord of all things Joe

Jacob the Madman rebalance:
- Speed reduced in first phase by half, damage doubled
- Damage one-shot in second phase, tripled speed
- Can now use Chris the Manipulator's ability
- Reduced health to 5000 from 10000
- Maddie's shield can be used, needed in second phase (unless you can do it without, that will be impressive)
- Removed the flashing light feature

- Reworked the credits

notes.title: A Quick Update
notes.content:
Hello Consequence Fans,

There will be an update shortly to Consequence. Consequence v1.2. This will introduce lots of balancing mechanics especially with the boss, and also introduce two new bosses. The art will also be updated. Here is a WIP for one of the new backgrounds to be added to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38797409/20e4c95c25f90f785ec8c622b34f573981648cea.png[/img]

I hope you enjoy version 1.2 as much as I enjoyed creating it

Noodle :)

notes.title: Consequence v1.1
notes.content:
Hello, a big thank you to everyone who has played the game so far, it is still not completely polished up, but I hope you have enjoyed it.

Patch notes:

- Added the pause menu throughout levels.
- Added the save and load feature
- Changed the music of the storm level
- A few bits of polish (fullscreen mode and better transtitions)

Expect a content update soon, a follow up to the final boss.

Thanks again
Noodle
